shots.name: lod-far-north
shots.note: The phase 2 baseline's lod-far scene: the a-north shot of local/reference/lod-check/lod-check.json, a high vantage above Riverwood looking north up the valley, where the native terrain LOD (#105) reaches the horizon with --terrain-radius 2 (portal's default ring of 8 fogs the LOD out). Held for the benchmark window rather than photographed.
